# Copilot Instructions for Bcentx

Bcentx is a global wealth intelligence platform.

## Build with

- Next.js (App Router)
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- Supabase PostgreSQL (later sprints)
- Supabase Auth (later sprints)
- Vercel

## Preserve

- Blue/green Bcentx V1 theme
- Learning Centre spirit
- Card-based UI
- Beginner-friendly educational tone
- Brand assets in `public/brand/` and `public/favicon/`

## Prioritize

- Trust
- Risk warnings
- Country-aware guidance
- Source-backed content
- Affiliate transparency
- Admin content workflow (later)
- SEO-ready pages

## Avoid

- Guaranteed-income claims
- Hype copy
- Hidden affiliate relationships
- Personalized financial / legal / tax advice
- Post-MVP features unless requested
- Overwriting `legacy/v1-static-site/` without approval
- Committing secrets or service role keys

## Docs to follow

- `docs/ai-context/README.md`
- `docs/build-log/BUILD_LOG.md`
- `docs/build-log/DECISIONS.md`
